verdict.rationale: Proa is a web framework, so official end-to-end testing tooling is a fair question for it. The evidence documents a dev server with auto-restart and stylesheet hot-reload. It also documents build-time WCAG/ARIA checks, lint warnings, and `proa fmt --check --verify`, but these are adjacent compile-time and format checks, not E2E testing. Nothing in the pack shows an official E2E test runner, browser automation integration, or test harness tied to the dev server.
